solves: Shows the main navigation of a product in a column on the left, in three modes (expanded, collapsed and mobile) and two states (ready and loading), so the person knows where they are and changes area with one click, with a flyout panel for the second level of the collapsed menu and for the third level.
use_when: For the main navigation of a product: one column on the left, with its areas and their pages.
In the expanded mode, on a wide screen, when the names of the areas help the person to choose.
In the collapsed mode, when the content needs the width: the rail shows the icons with a balloon, and an item with children opens a flyout panel next to it.
In the mobile mode, on a narrow screen: the menu opens over the screen, with the scrim behind, and closes with the close button.
With loading, while the list of the product is still arriving.
With the corner button, for the main action of the product, such as All applications.
do_not_use_when: For the tabs inside a page: use nph-tabs.
For the actions of a button: use nph-dropdown-menu.
For the top navigation: use nph-navigation-menu.
For the page trail: use nph-breadcrumb.
For the account of the person: it belongs to the product header, not to the menu.
For a page action, such as save, filter or export, in the corner button: use nph-button in the page bar.
The collapsed mode on a phone: use the mobile mode.

mode.constraint: The Figma modo. expanded shows the full logo, the search and the names; collapsed shows the logo mark, the collapse button, the rail buttons and the corner button as an icon; mobile is the expanded menu over the screen. The product chooses it and switches to mobile below the md breakpoint; the collapse button also switches expanded and collapsed. Reflects because the CSS reads it. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

open.constraint: The mobile menu opened. Only in mobile mode. The product opens it with a button of its own and the menu sets it to false when the person closes it. Setting it from code fires nothing.

loading.constraint: The Figma estado carregando. nph-skeleton rows in place of the items, with aria-busy on the list. The logo, the search and the corner button stay.

items.constraint: The entries, in order, as data (property only). A label entry ({ type: label, text }) names the group that follows it. A link (type absent or link) has label, icon and href and optionally active, counter, disabled, tooltip, actions, actionsLabel and value. A group (type group) has label, icon and children, and optionally expanded, disabled, tooltip, actions, actionsLabel and value. A child has label and href, or options (the third level, each with label and href); active, disabled, tooltip and value. Two levels in the list; the third only in a flyout panel. The menu replaces the list when a group opens or closes and never changes the objects of the consumer. An entry that cannot be drawn is left out and emits console.error in development, once per cause. An empty list is a mount.

label.constraint: The accessible name of the navigation landmark, already localized, such as Main menu. Empty draws the menu and emits one console.error in development.

logo-src.constraint: The address of the full logo, an image of the brand library that Nephos does not export. It has no dark version yet (task DSA-72, D-2). Empty draws no logo.

logo-mark-src.constraint: The address of the logo mark of the collapsed mode. Empty uses logo-src.

logo-label.constraint: The name of the product. It is the accessible name of the logo link, or the alternative text of the logo when it has no logo-href.

logo-href.constraint: The page the logo leads to. Empty draws the logo as an image, not as a link.

search-label.constraint: The accessible name of the search. The search is drawn, in the expanded and mobile modes, only with it. It is an nph-input.

search-placeholder.constraint: The hint inside the search, already localized.

search-value.constraint: The text in the search. The menu writes it as the person types and fires nph-search-change.

collapse-label.constraint: The accessible name of the collapse button while the menu is expanded, such as Collapse menu. Required while the button is shown; without it the button is not drawn and the menu emits console.error in development.

expand-label.constraint: The accessible name of the collapse button while the menu is collapsed, such as Expand menu. Required while the button is shown.

close-label.constraint: The accessible name of the close button of the mobile menu. Required in mobile mode; without it the button is not drawn and the menu emits console.error in development.

corner-label.constraint: The main action of the product, such as All applications. It is the text of the corner button in the expanded and mobile modes and its accessible name in the collapsed mode. Empty draws no corner button.

hide-collapse-button.constraint: The Figma botão de recolher, on by default. Turns the collapse button off.

hide-corner-button.constraint: The Figma botão do canto, on by default. Turns the corner button off.

empty-text.constraint: The short message in place of the list when there are no items, already localized. Empty draws nothing.

error-text.constraint: The short message in place of the list when the list could not load, already localized. It is an alert and wins over the items.

nph-mode-change.constraint: Fired when the person switches the menu with the collapse button, with detail.mode, the new mode. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots. The product keeps the mode. Setting mode from code fires nothing.

nph-close.constraint: Fired before the mobile menu closes when the person asks, with detail.source: close-button, escape or scrim. It bubbles, crosses shadow roots and is cancelable: preventDefault keeps the menu open. Setting open from code fires nothing.

nph-group-toggle.constraint: Fired when the person opens or closes a group of the expanded list, with detail.value, the value of the group, and detail.expanded, the new state. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots.

nph-search-change.constraint: Fired as the person types in the search, with detail.value. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots.

nph-corner-action.constraint: Fired when the person presses the corner button. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots.

nph-item-select.constraint: The action the person chose in the more actions of an item, fired again on the host with detail.value, detail.checked and detail.item, the value of the item. It bubbles.

mode.choose_when: expanded on a wide screen; collapsed when the content needs the width; mobile on a narrow screen.
do_not_combine_with: collapsed on a phone: use mobile.

loading.choose_when: While the list of the product is still arriving.

corner-button.choose_when: When the product has a main action: its label in corner-label. Off with hide-corner-button.
do_not_combine_with: A page action, such as save or filter.

rest.changes_for_user: The panel floats on sidebar/panel-background, with a 1 px border in sidebar/panel-border and no shadow.

loading.changes_for_user: nph-skeleton rows in place of the items; the logo, the search and the corner button stay; the list is aria-busy.

flyout-open.changes_for_user: The flyout panel opens next to its opener, with the name of the opener as its title; its opener shows aria-expanded true.

focus.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus draws the 1 px focus/border border and the focus/halo halo outside the collapse button, the close button, the logo link and the flyout option.

disabled.changes_for_user: A disabled option or item at state/disabled-opacity, with no hover and no focus.

business_rules: The product chooses the mode, the current item and what opens; the menu only shows. The collapse button is the one exception: it switches expanded and collapsed and reports it.
Only the navigation scrolls; the top and the foot stay fixed.
Two levels in the list. The third level opens in a flyout panel next to its opener; there is no fourth level.
A flyout panel opens on a click, Enter or Space, never on hover. Opening another panel of the same level closes the one open. Esc closes the innermost and gives the focus back to its opener.
A click or the focus outside closes the flyout panel; opening it closes the balloon of its opener.
The mobile menu is a modal dialog: the page is inert, the focus is trapped, Esc, the close button and the scrim close it.
The menu does not write words of its own: every visible text and accessible name comes from the product.

tokens.width: sidebar/panel-width expanded and mobile; layout/sidebar-collapsed collapsed
tokens.spacing: sidebar/panel-spacing on the sides (collapsed: sidebar/rail-padding) and between top, middle and foot; space/section at top and bottom; sidebar/section-gap between the search, the separator and the navigation
tokens.logo: sidebar/logo-max-height; sidebar/logo-mark-size in the collapsed mode
tokens.corner_button: nph-button primary solid; nph-button icon-only plus when collapsed
tokens.flyout: sidebar/flyout-background, sidebar/flyout-border, sidebar/flyout-radius, elevation/dropdown, sidebar/flyout-title, sidebar/flyout-foreground, sidebar/flyout-option-hover
tokens.flyout_option: control/height-default, sidebar/item-padding, sidebar/item-radius, sidebar/item-foreground-active, sidebar/item-foreground-open, state/disabled-opacity
tokens.motion: motion/expand-duration and motion/expand-easing for the width; motion/enter-* and motion/exit-* for the panels

ai_hints: Use nph-sidebar for the main navigation of the product; for the tabs of a page, use nph-tabs.
Give every entry its text, its icon and its href; mark only the current page as active.
Switch to the mobile mode below the md breakpoint and open the menu with a button of your own.
Pass the label of the landmark, the labels of the collapse and close buttons and every text in the language of the product.
Use the corner button only for the main action of the product.
Put a third level only in the options of a child: it opens in a flyout panel.

accessibility.semantics: A navigation landmark with a name; the items are links, and a group, a collapse button and an opener of a flyout panel are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The mobile menu is a modal dialog with the same name. The flyout panel is a group named by its title.
accessibility.accessible_name: label names the landmark and the dialog. The collapse button carries collapse-label or expand-label, and the balloon is its name. In the collapsed mode, each rail button carries the item name in aria-label and in the balloon. The logo is a link named by logo-label. The current item carries aria-current page.
keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab: move through the logo link, the collapse button, the search, each item, subitem or rail button and the corner button, in reading order; the next Tab after an opener enters its flyout panel.
Enter and Space: follow a link; open and close a group, a flyout panel or the options of a child.
Esc: closes the innermost flyout panel and gives the focus back to its opener; with none open, closes the mobile menu.
accessibility.focus: focus/border and focus/halo on every focusable piece of the menu. The corner button keeps the default focus of nph-button.
accessibility.contrast: Every text of the menu passes 4.5:1 on its background, in light and dark, in the seven brands; the focus border passes 3:1 against the panel and against the flyout panel.
accessibility.color_alternative: The active item uses the brand color, text/label-md and a solid icon; the active rail button turns its icon solid; the open flyout option uses the same color with the arrow, and the weight separates active from open.

invalid_combinations: A mode outside expanded, collapsed and mobile — the menu draws nothing.
A link without href, unless disabled — it leads nowhere.
A group without children — it opens nothing.
A child with options and an href, or with options and active — it opens a panel, it is not a page.
A fourth level — the third level has no children.
anti_patterns: Putting a page action in the corner button.
Using the collapsed mode on a phone.
Opening the flyout panel far from its opener.
Putting the account of the person in the menu.
Writing a line on every row: the one line is between the search and the navigation.
